# IPCC — Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change

> The IPCC is the UN's authoritative body for assessing climate science, impacts, and solutions through comprehensive assessment reports and working group analyses.

The IPCC synthesizes peer-reviewed climate science to inform international climate policy and negotiations. It operates through three working groups (Physical Science Basis, Impacts and Adaptation, Mitigation), a task force on greenhouse gas inventories, and a bureau-led governance structure with national focal points.

## Key Topics

- Sixth Assessment Report (AR6)
- Working Group I (Physical Science Basis)
- Working Group II (Impacts, Adaptation, Vulnerability)
- Working Group III (Mitigation of Climate Change)
- Task Force on National Greenhouse Gas Inventories
- Climate Change Assessment
- Global Warming
- Mitigation
- Adaptation
- Greenhouse Gas Inventories
- IPCC Bureau
- Synthesis Report
- Special Reports
- Expert Meetings
- UNFCCC

## Assessment Reports & Core Resources

- [Reports](https://www.ipcc.ch/reports): IPCC assessment reports including AR6 synthesis and mitigation/adaptation reports
- [Synthesis Report](https://www.ipcc.ch/synthesis-report): AR6 Synthesis Report overview and climate science assessment findings
- [Library](https://www.ipcc.ch/library): IPCC reports, methodology documents, and climate science research library

## Organization & Governance

- [About](https://www.ipcc.ch/about): IPCC organization structure, mission, objectives, and international collaboration framework
- [Working Groups](https://www.ipcc.ch/working-groups): IPCC Working Groups I, II, III structure and greenhouse gas inventory task force
- [Bureau Portal](https://www.ipcc.ch/bureau): IPCC Bureau leadership, governance structure, and bureau member information
- [Focal Points Portal](https://www.ipcc.ch/focal-points): National Focal Points directory and organizational structure for climate assessments
- [Documentation](https://www.ipcc.ch/documentation): IPCC organizational procedures, governance structure, and climate change documentation

## Activities & Updates

- [Activities](https://www.ipcc.ch/activities): Upcoming events, expert meetings, and lead author meetings calendar
- [News](https://www.ipcc.ch/news): IPCC news announcements, job vacancies, and organizational updates

## Support & Navigation

- [Help](https://www.ipcc.ch/help): FAQ, navigation guides, and tutorials for website and report access
- [Homepage](https://www.ipcc.ch): IPCC homepage covering climate change assessment, reports, and international climate policy

## Multilingual Resources

- [العربية](https://www.ipcc.ch/languages-2/arabic): Arabic language version of IPCC reports and Sixth Assessment Report
- [简体中文](https://www.ipcc.ch/languages-2/chinese): Chinese language version of IPCC reports and assessment materials
- [Français](https://www.ipcc.ch/languages-2/francais): French language version of IPCC publications and assessment reports
- [Español](https://www.ipcc.ch/languages-2/spanish): Spanish language version of IPCC publications and assessment reports
- [Русский](https://www.ipcc.ch/languages-2/russian): Russian language version of IPCC reports and climate assessments
